activities.title: Add one clip to "My Digital Skills Journey"
activities.intro: Work in your Lab 4 file. Pick one path: a video file, an online video or your own voice. Keep it under 30 seconds.

items: A video file: record 10 seconds of your desk or workspace with your phone, copy it to the PC, then Insert › Video › This Device.
An online video: Insert › Video › Online Videos and paste a YouTube link from this course, e.g. a GCFLearnFree tutorial.
Your voice: Insert › Audio › Record Audio. Say one sentence: "The skill I'll use most at work is…"
Resize the clip so it doesn't cover your text. Set Start to When Clicked On.
Trim if needed, then press Shift + F5 and click it. Does it play?

blocks.prompt: Which path did you choose, and did your clip play in Slide Show?
Keep your clip under how many seconds?
Which path is the fastest and needs no internet?
For a live talk, which Start setting lets the clip wait for you?

help: On a slow connection? Choose the voice path: it needs no internet.
A headset or phone earphones with a mic sound better than the laptop mic.

activities.title: Live sound check over our meeting
activities.intro: Two volunteers play their clip, first without sound sharing, then with it. Everyone else: react, don't unmute.

items: Volunteer shares screen without sound and plays their clip.
Audience reacts 🔇 if they hear nothing.
Volunteer stops, shares again with "Share sound" ticked.
Audience reacts 🔊 when they hear it clearly.

blocks.prompt: What did you notice? Was the volume comfortable, the voice clear, and did the clip start on the presenter's click?
In Zoom's Share Screen window, what must you tick before you click Share?
In Google Meet, which way includes the clip's sound?

activities.title: Quick check: no sound on Zoom

blocks.prompt: On Zoom, your video plays, but participants hear nothing. The most likely fix?
options: Change the slide transition to Fade
Set the video to Loop until Stopped
